summary: @servicetitan/hammer-icon 1.2.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares itself as an icon library but ships a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript bundle (`math_init.js`) that is not listed in the `files` allowlist (which restricts published contents to SVG icons under `mdi/` and `CHANGELOG.md`). The `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, marks it executable, and uses it to run `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. The payload carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and is identifier-mangled with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` over `n7gIxM`), consistent with obfuscator.io output — a shape that hides readable strings from Node-based inspection tooling. An icon package has no functional need for the Bun runtime; the alternate-runtime dropper pattern is used to execute install-time code that standard Node-level scanners will not follow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
